sources.title: Banned F gas for refilling equipment
Recover, reclaim and recycle F gas

facts.source_fact: A system affected by the high-GWP refill ban may use reclaimed F gas above GWP 2,500 until 2030 only.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve reclaimed status and end year.

facts.source_fact: Recovered and recycled F gas above GWP 2,500 may be used until 2030 only when recovered from similar equipment by the relevant business or servicer.
The reclaimed and recycled options are alternatives to use of virgin high-GWP gas.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat as permission for virgin gas.

facts.source_fact: Retrofilling means removing all F gas and replacing it with a gas having the lowest possible GWP.
HFC448A and HFC449A are given as examples for retrofilling, subject to manufacturer recommendation.
facts.expected_handling: Treat examples as non-exclusive and preserve manufacturer advice.

facts.source_fact: Replacing the refrigeration system with equipment using a lower-GWP refrigerant is another compliance option.
Reclaimed, recycled and retrofit routes are operational options after a refill-ban applicability determination.
Recovery/recycling terminology must not be used interchangeably with virgin gas.
The 2030 date is a temporal limit for the high-GWP reclaimed/recycled options.
Choosing an option does not establish a measured emissions saving.
